learningObjectives: Explain the physiological or methodological basis of EEG & QEEG Clinical Integration Capstone.
Apply EEG & QEEG Clinical Integration Capstone to technically valid clinical interpretation.
Identify artifacts, confounds and limits that could alter conclusions.
Communicate findings without exceeding the evidence or professional scope.

mechanismMap.label: Core concept
mechanismMap.detail: A high-quality workflow begins with a focused question, valid acquisition, expert raw-EEG review, transparent quantitative analysis and integration with clinical evidence.

mechanismMap.label: Mechanism
mechanismMap.detail: Conclusions should be tiered: observed signal features, plausible physiological interpretations, alternatives, limitations and actions. Urgent medical findings are escalated.

mechanismMap.label: Clinical integration
mechanismMap.detail: Consolidates safe use across psychology, neuropsychology and neurofeedback settings.

mechanismMap.label: Boundary condition
mechanismMap.detail: The greatest risk is not missing a colourful pattern; it is overstating what that pattern means.
